first.text:
Give a concise research second opinion in English. Use only the material in this prompt; do not execute code, edit files, inspect credentials, or contact people. Aim for at most 900 words; this is a soft instruction, not an enforced output/token/cost cap. Separate supported facts, assumptions, counterexamples, and the next cheapest falsifiable check. Do not claim model execution, independent scientific validation, or established novelty.

You are an independent skeptical research analyst. Reply in English, at most 650 words. Use only the supplied evidence, do not execute tools or access files, network, credentials, code or experiments. This is a second opinion; it cannot authorize experiments or validate novelty. We need one falsifiable, low-compute next research question, not marketing language.

Project: geometry-aware world modeling, on an Apple Silicon Mac without remote GPU. Our current scientific state is NO_METHOD_SELECTED; no new method validated. Camera-response diagnostics are separate ongoing baseline checks and have no available outcome in this prompt.

Verified prior-art evidence:
1. ReMind, Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution, arXiv 2605.25333v2 (2026 preprint, venue acceptance unverified), https://arxiv.org/html/2605.25333v2 . Event-informed training frame graphs protect clean anchors and corrupt interruption nodes, teaching nonlocal retrieval with camera/time-addressed references. This means distant event history and event anchors are already prior art.
2. Official ReMind repository commit bf316a30b10f444e15adf5ddf710fa9f97e34ee9, https://github.com/Applied-Intuition-Open-Source/ReMind . Inspected released 5B DMD inference: inference.py calls generate_from_preset; remind_inference.py supplies an image or contiguous video prefix; known_context.py marks first prefix_frames; dmd_rollout.py appends each chunk and attends accumulated history. No automatic event selector found on this specific route; this bounded absence does not prove novelty. cache_adapter.py:190-240 already contains replace_chunk_in_cache, which replaces a chosen slot at its original temporal offset with unchanged cache length but invokes the generator again. Equal cache length is therefore not equal total computation. This route must not be conflated with all paper training experiments.
3. General established alternatives include current/recent state, constant-velocity or timestamp-aware kinematic filtering, recent motion pair + greedy spatial coverage, and recent motion pair + coverage + latest reliable event anchor. Partial observability/belief-state selection is established, so relabeling this as new would be insufficient.

Candidate question, not claimed innovation: Holding available historical frame count, observed information, timestamp/calibration access, frozen generator, denoiser calls, and selection computation fixed, does replacing one spatially redundant frame with an earlier visible dynamics-changing event improve later out-of-view state prediction beyond those alternatives? An unobserved random branch cannot be recovered from identical evidence. A local diagnostic can test the information-loss premise before any large video experiment.

Provide: (A) strongest reason this is ordinary prior art or not identifiable; (B) one precise falsifier and honest measurable dependent variable; (C) minimum fair comparison including a strong classical baseline, information/computation parity and train/test separation; (D) a decision rule for abandon/narrow/proceed to more testing, without invented thresholds or results. Distinguish event-based frame selection from the generator learning to use supplied history and from a cache replacement primitive. Flag any needed evidence not supplied. Do not assume a positive effect or publishability.

Traceability note: a prior separate DSH camera reviewer made a sign mistake: for delta = error_identity - error_prescribed_H, correctly followed plus and minus camera rotations can both yield positive delta with their respective H. That correction is saved by root and is not evidence about this candidate question. Treat all model opinions, including yours, as fallible.
